denominators.definition: Unique NHLE ListEntry values in layers 0, 1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 whose official feature geometry intersects at least one pinned December 2025 BFC LAD polygon.
denominators.method: ArcGIS esriSpatialRelIntersects per LAD; union by ListEntry; retain all memberships
